coverage: First-round reference profile; identification and biographical details await review.

attestations.text: BUJANTAI 布占泰, beile of the Ula tribe, a part of the Manchu Hûlun nation, belonged to the Nara clan. He was descended from the same ancestor, Nacibulu 納奇卜祿, as the chieftains of the Hada tribe (see under Wan).
